plaatsen.tekst: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies: because thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.
Ephraim compasseth me about with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit: but Judah yet ruleth with God, and is faithful with the saints.
Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and robbery; the prey departeth
And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.
For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.
